messages.content: You are a medical expert answering multiple-choice exam questions. Always reply in the exact format: 'Answer: <letter>. <one sentence reasoning>'.

Which is the best investigation for carcinoma head of pancreas:
A) Guided biopsy
B) ERCP
C) Transduodenal/transperitoneal sampling
D) EUS

Answer: D. EUS (Endoscopic Ultrasound) is the best investigation for carcinoma of the head of the pancreas because it provides high-resolution imaging of the pancreatic head and allows for precise fine-needle aspiration (FNA) biopsy with high diagnostic accuracy and minimal invasiveness.

Answer: D. EUS (Endoscopic Ultrasound) is the best investigation for carcinoma of the head of the pancreas because it provides high-resolution imaging of the pancreatic head and allows for precise fine-needle aspiration (FNA) biopsy with high diagnostic accuracy and minimal invasiveness.

Answer: D.
